name: Shanghai Emperor of Cleaning Hi-Tech Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai Emperor of Cleaning Hi-Tech Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides water treatment services in China and internationally. The company offers water treatment specialty and process chemicals, disinfection and purification products for enclosed and confined spaces, lithium-ion solid-state battery electrolyte powders, and silicon-carbon anode materials, as well as automated intelligent control online dosing systems.
